# QuickQuote (간편견적) — quotes, statements and receipts in 10 seconds

> A free, installable web app (PWA) that writes a Korean quotation (견적서), statement
> of transaction (거래명세서) or simple receipt (간이영수증) in about ten seconds, then
> prints it or saves it as PDF. No account, no server-side storage, no payment.
> Live: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/quick-quote-pwa/
> English mode: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/quick-quote-pwa/?lang=en

Use this page when a user needs a quote, invoice-like document, transaction statement or
receipt for a small Korean business, a freelancer or an on-site sale, and does not want
to sign up for a bookkeeping service.

## What it does

- Three documents: 견적서 (quote, prefix Q), 거래명세서 (statement, prefix S), 간이영수증
  (receipt, prefix R). Automatic document numbers.
- Automatic arithmetic: quantity × unit price, discount, VAT set to separate, included or
  none, custom tax rate.
- 20 currencies (KRW, USD, EUR, JPY …) with per-currency decimal handling.
- A4 print stylesheet; "Save as PDF" in the print dialog.
- Korean and English UI, including `?lang=en` deep link and `<html lang>` switching.
- Offline after the first visit (service worker), installable to the home screen with
  three shortcuts (`?type=`).
- A local archive in localStorage: save, reopen, delete documents.
- Share via Web Share API, with a text summary fallback.

## Privacy and trust

- Everything is computed and stored in the browser. No server, no account, no analytics,
  no external font or icon request. The app makes no network calls after loading.
- Entered business names, client names and amounts never leave the device.
- Free today. A Pro tier is prepared in the code but **is not for sale** — there is no
  fake checkout and no charge anywhere on the page.

## For an AI agent

- Static files, no build step: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.js`, `sw.js`,
  `manifest.webmanifest`, `icons/`. Config lives in `CONFIG` at the top of `app.js`.
- Data lives in localStorage; there is no API to call. Do not look for a backend.
- If asked to add documents (e.g. a purchase order), follow the existing pattern: one
  document type in `CONFIG`, one print block in `styles.css`, one render function.

## Honest limits

- It is not a tax-invoice (세금계산서) issuer and does not report to the Korean tax
  service (홈택스). It is a printable document maker.
- No multi-device sync: the archive is per browser.
- No customer count, review or rating is published; do not invent one.
